recipe.visualDefinition: A surreal first-person perspective image where a guitar neck transforms into a rollercoaster track ascending into a cloudy sky, with a pair of hands gripping a safety bar in the foreground.
coreVisualRelationships: The guitar frets and strings converge at a sharp vanishing point to simulate track depth.
The hands in the foreground establish a physical connection to the viewer's perspective.
The warm wood tones of the guitar contrast against the cool blue and white of the sky.
coreInvariants: Visual pun merging a musical instrument with a thrill ride.
Tightly cropped foreground hands showing tension.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The guitar neck dominates the center, scaling from the bottom edge to a distant point in the upper-middle.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The two clenched hands gripping a horizontal chrome bar at the bottom center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the hands, follow the converging lines of the guitar strings upward, and loop back via the curved track loop at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The sky provides breathing room around the central vertical structure.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm browns and ambers from the wood of the guitar neck.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Muted blue and white from the atmospheric sky background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright red for the primary display typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the dark foreground shadows and the bright, hazy sky.

letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses a fluid, connected script with a heavy horizontal underline.
Secondary text uses a wide, blocky sans-serif contained within a solid black bar.
Script features thick-to-thin stroke variation typical of brush lettering.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'D' and 'J' have elongated, sweeping swashes.
The underline bar integrates directly into the tail of the final letter.

composition.relationshipToImage: contained in a black rectangular callout

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-energy script paired with a rigid, geometric industrial sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Horizontal black bar for secondary text
Double horizontal rule under primary script

preserve: The red color of the script
The wide tracking of the subtitle

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the fluid, hand-drawn energy of the 80s rock era.
Matches the wide, technical feel of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a first-person perspective photo of two hands with white knuckles gripping a chrome safety bar. Looking forward, a giant guitar neck serves as a rollercoaster track, extending upward into a blue sky with white clouds. The guitar frets and strings should converge sharply toward the top.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large red script logo in the top left corner with a double underline. In the top right, place a horizontal black bar containing white, wide-spaced, all-caps sans-serif text.

verificationChecks: Does the guitar neck look like a functional track?
Is the red script legible against the white background?
Are the hands showing visible tension?

adjustableVariables: Wood grain detail on the guitar neck
mustRedesign: Exact watch face details on the wrist
postGenerationChecks: Check that the strings align with the frets correctly.
Ensure the hands look realistic and strained.
Verify the vanishing point is centered horizontally.
Confirm the black text bar is perfectly horizontal.
recipe.reuseFormula: Perspective-driven visual pun + Hand-drawn script + Industrial sans-serif callout.
